faq: Can my existing React Native app move to Expo?
Usually yes. Most apps move without trouble, and we list any libraries that need a replacement before you order. If your app has custom native code, we use Expo development builds to keep it.
Will every feature work on the web?
Most screens do. Phone-only features such as Bluetooth or some camera tools have no web equivalent, so we agree a simple fallback for each one, like a message or a file upload.
Where does the web version live?
We deploy to a host you choose, such as Vercel or Netlify, using your own account. Free tiers are enough for many apps. Hosting costs, if any, are billed to you by the host.
Do I need an Expo account?
A free Expo account is enough for builds and updates. You create it, add us as a collaborator, and we configure the project. Paid Expo plans are only needed for higher build volumes.
